deepdive.sec: Solar EPC & Energy-Storage Integration (utility-scale) + O&M annuity

bull_bear.body: Diversified lender base (added India + local South-Africa lines; lead bank raised limits; +INR3,200 cr fresh lines). Term loans repay this year & next → "almost deleveraged" on fund-based after. Negative-WC discipline maintained. Regular dividend intent flagged; growth funded off customer advances not equity.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Execution ramp / H2 back-ended** — the entire guide rests on Q3-Q4; any further LOA slippage repeats Q1.
- **Litigation overhang:** total claims ~INR1,800 cr; 2 US project claims in court (2-3 yrs); Australia arbitration ~INR200 cr (INR110 cr under promoter LD-indemnity); ~INR800 cr receivables indemnity-covered (INR120-130 cr expected this year); ~INR3,800 cr contingent "frivolous" claims (no cash-out expected). BG invocation risk on delayed orders is nil (contract dates not yet started).
- **DCR/module-price & BESS-localization** policy uncertainty on future bids (locked on current orders).
- **Reliance timing/quantum** entirely on Reliance's rollout schedule.
- Domestic ordering slow for a 2nd straight quarter.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Candid on the miss ("assumptions were on track… unfortunately all new orders' LOAs delayed"), disciplined on not chasing aggressive bids, and blunt on the H2 pressure ("Boss, we have no option… we have to perform"). CFO detailed and consistent on claims/indemnity mechanics. Reliance answers appropriately guarded (arm's-length, terms open). Tone = confident-but-accountable; execution is the credibility test next two quarters.
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- **The revenue miss is a timing artefact, not demand loss** — existing UOV was late-stage (supplies already booked) and new orders slipped LOA; H2 mechanically re-loads.
- **Reliance optionality sits entirely outside the 10-15% guide** — any Kutch orders are upside, but on Reliance's clock; likely majority free-issue supply, arm's-length.
- **DCR is the swing factor for the sector** — SWSOLAR locked Coal India prices, so it is comparatively insulated vs peers exposed to the module-price upsurge; watch it as the first DCR-model proof point.
- O&M is quietly inflecting to a INR400-450 cr, ~20%-GM annuity — a stabilising counterweight to lumpy EPC.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- "Strong Balance Sheet" markers as of June 2026: Net worth INR 709 cr, Net D/E 0.9x and a BBB+ credit rating.
- "Bank borrowings has decreased by ~INR 129 cr versus last quarter due to scheduled repayments done" — gross debt of 1,035 (Jun-26) versus 1,164 (Mar-26); "Debt levels remain stable and term debt continues to decrease with repayments".
- Net working capital "continues to remain negative at INR 260 crore as of Jun 2026" (versus -329 at Q4FY26 and -348 at Q1FY26); receivable days 161 (Jun-26) versus 138 (Mar-26) and payable days 157 versus 135.
- Raised INR 1,500 crore through the QIP route in 2024.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- **International EPC:** 4 projects (South Africa, Spain, Italy) at completion "within/above targeted margins"; 3 new won (2 South Africa + 1 Egypt) start execution ~this quarter. Nigeria slow (elections) — no FY27 revenue assumed.
- **O&M:** record **18.3 GW** peak (from 13.5 GW) — fed by own EPC completions (5.8 GW DC commissioned last year) + third-party (1.2 GW single order). Steady annuity, low overhead, ~20% GM.
- **BESS:** executing 1 project (battery client-supplied, free-issue → no duty/regulatory margin risk currently); future turnkey BESS margins ~PV-BoS (~10%), battery portion can be thinner/turbulent. Sourcing cautious — Indian "Make-in-India" battery market immature (assembly only); evaluating partners.
- **Floating solar:** executing India's largest with NTPC-DVC (Tilaiya, Jharkhand); more NTPC-DVC + state tenders coming.
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.body:
- **Execution/scale credibility:** ~28 GW executed globally; 4 international projects delivered at/above target margins — the basis for the Egypt/marquee-developer wins and rising ticket sizes.
- **Negative working-capital + back-to-back procurement** model: customer advances + supplier LCs (90-180 days) fund growth; management frames conservatism as the durability edge as the cycle matures.
- **O&M stickiness:** customers migrate O&M to SWSOLAR after seeing plant performance — annuity moat.

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers (listed names)

business.body:
- Claims to be a "Leading Solar EPC solutions provider in the world", a "Leading Solar O&M player globally" and a "Leading Solar EPC player in India"; it was "Ranked No. 1 solar EPC in the world by IHS Markit" (2024) and "Ranked 2nd largest O&M player in the world by Wood Mackenzie" (2021).
- Describes itself as "One of the only Global Pure-Play Solar EPC players with a significant presence and operational experience across geographies".
- Global recognition anchors: EPC and O&M of Abu Dhabi 1,177 MWp, "One of the world's largest single location PV plant"; domestically, "3GW+ in 2 projects" including one of India's largest PV plants at Khavda, Gujarat and one of India's largest BESS projects.
- Differentiators listed as Experience (repeat business from complex large-scale EPC), Expeditious decision making, Cost Effective, Global Presence, Strong Relationships ("A Bankable Player") and Talent Pool (strong in-house design and engineering team).
- Constructed "India's first floating Solar Project - 455 kWp in Kerala, India".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Ownership] In 2022 "Reliance New Energy acquired 40% stake in Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Limited".
- [Demerger] The 2017 milestone records the "Demerger of S&W Solar from S&W Group", with incorporation of a subsidiary in Spain and start of US operations; the company listed on BSE and NSE in 2019.
- [M&A] Expanded operations in Australia in 2018 "by acquiring a controlling stake in GCO Electrical Pty Ltd".
- [Order book mix] "India Focused Order Book * — India 78.3%, International 21.7%", footnoted "* As of Mar 2026".
- [Customer concentration] NTPC is a repeat marquee customer — a 1.6 GW domestic EPC contract (2023) followed by "a second consecutive mega order (1,500 MW) from NTPC".
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: EPC GM guided **8-10%** (mix-dependent: turnkey low-%/high-absolute, BoS ~10%); DCR module-price shock largely hedged on Coal India (price locked). Overheads flat in absolute terms, falling as % on growth → operating leverage in H2. O&M GM ~20%. Forex helped reported EBITDA this quarter.
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

latest_quarter.body:
- **Q1FY27 (this):** Revenue INR1,590 cr (-10% YoY, down QoQ) on delayed LOAs/late-stage UOV; GM 9.9%; operational EBITDA INR78 cr (4.9%); reported EBITDA INR96 cr (forex); PAT INR53 cr (+36%). **Record UOV INR13,000 cr** after USD560 m Egypt win (1,000 MW + 600 MWh BESS, 50-50 JV). O&M 18.3 GW (+40% YoY rev). WC -INR260 cr. Guide trimmed to **10-15% FY27 (ex-Reliance)**; Q2 soft, H2 heavy (Q4 >INR2,500 cr). O&M INR400-450 cr FY27. Egypt NTP Sept-26 → rev Q4FY27. Coal India DCR orders price-locked, LOA pending.
- _next → check: Q2 revenue (mgmt flags soft) then H2 ramp to ~INR2,500-3,000 cr/qtr; Egypt NTP by Sept; Coal India + Reliance LOAs landing; O&M rev toward INR400-450 cr from Q3; UOV >INR10,000 cr at FY27-end; indemnity realisation INR120-130 cr; DCR-model margin outcome._
latest_quarter.title: QoQ change log (fill each quarter)

outlook.body:
- **Revenue growth FY27: 10-15%** (ex-Reliance) — trimmed from ">15%" last quarter; high FY26 base.
- **Cadence:** Q2 also soft (~Q1 range); **H2 heavy — Q4 target >INR2,500 cr**, potentially ~INR3,000 cr; H2 execution must exceed H1 materially.
- **EPC gross margin: 8-10%** (turnkey lower % but higher absolute; BoS ~10%); marginal EBITDA-margin impact, offset by operating leverage.
- **O&M: revenue INR400-450 cr FY27** (vs INR268 cr FY26); gross margin **~20%** stabilised; full 18.3 GW contributes **from Q3FY27**.
- **Order book/UOV: >INR10,000 cr at FY27-end**; order-inflow growth **10-15%** over last year.
- **Egypt:** NTP expected **Sept-2026**, 13-15 month build → revenue contribution from **Q4FY27**.
outlook.title: Guidance (CRITICAL — verify next quarter)

outlook.body:
- **UOV INR13,000 cr** (record). 6 turnkey projects (3 India + 3 international) worth ~INR9,000 cr **yet to start** — meaningful contribution H2FY27; large-project advances should improve WC.
- **Egypt West Minya:** 1,000 MW AC solar + 600 MWh BESS, ~USD560 m, 50-50 JV with Hassan Allam Construction — full EPC scope (PV, battery, grid/transmission, BoP).
- **Bid pipeline 27.7 GW, ~90% India** (solar PV + BESS); management sees **INR45,000-50,000 cr** of orders in Q3-Q4 (~25 GW utility + 35 GWh BESS). BESS ordering value expected ~equal to PV over time.
- This quarter industry orders concluded only **INR6,400 cr** (SWSOLAR expected >INR20,000 cr) — deferred by DCR/module-price uncertainty; SWSOLAR stayed patient/margin-selective, deliberately not chasing aggressive bids.
- **Coal India** orders (L1, **DCR category, price locked**) awaiting LOA — first DCR-model demonstration; Reliance order LOA also delayed.
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body:
- **Reliance New Energy (Kutch RE hub):** 5.5-lakh-acre RTC ambition, 40 GWh battery Gigafactory (→120 GWh pathway) commissioning this year; SWSOLAR working on technical config/execution readiness, "confident of a large share" — **arm's-length, terms not closed** (upside not in the 10-15% guide).
- BESS is the structural second leg (Govt 500 MW-by-2030 target; 35-40 GWh opportunity over 2-3 yrs).
- O&M CAGR to compound (adding ~4-5 GW/yr own + ~2 GW third-party).
